points.title: 童年与神启
points.description: 贞德出生于法国东北部洛林地区的一个小村庄多米雷，父母是农民。在这个动荡的百年战争时期，村庄经常受到英国军队和勃艮第派的威胁。从13岁起，贞德开始声称听到圣米迦勒、圣凯瑟琳和圣玛格丽特的声音，这些声音告诉她要拯救法国，帮助王太子查理七世加冕为王，并将英国人赶出法国。这些神启经历塑造了她一生的使命感和坚定信念。
points.descriptionEn: Born in the small village of Domrémy in northeastern France, Joan came from a peasant family. During the turbulent Hundred Years' War, her village was frequently threatened by English and Burgundian forces. From the age of 13, Joan began claiming to hear the voices of Saint Michael, Saint Catherine, and Saint Margaret, who told her to save France, help the Dauphin Charles VII to his rightful throne, and expel the English from French soil. These divine visions shaped her lifelong sense of mission and unwavering faith.

points.title: 寻求支持
points.description: 1429年初，贞德前往瓦朗谢讷寻求罗伯特·德·巴audricourt将军的支持。最初，巴audricourt将军和教会官员对她的声称持怀疑态度，认为她可能是个骗子或精神病患者。然而，在贞德准确预言了奥尔良附近的法国军队在帕泰战役中的胜利后，巴audricourt的态度有所软化，最终同意护送她前往希农城堡面见查理七世。这一决定为贞德提供了前往王宫的机会，使她能够向国王展示自己的使命。
points.descriptionEn: Early in 1429, Joan traveled to Valenciennes to seek support from Lord Robert de Baudricourt. Initially, Baudricourt and church officials were skeptical of her claims, suspecting she might be a fraud or mentally ill. However, after Joan accurately predicted the French army's victory near Orléans at the Battle of the Herrings, Baudricourt's attitude softened, and he eventually agreed to escort her to Chinon Castle to meet Charles VII. This decision provided Joan with the opportunity to present her mission to the king.

points.title: 奥尔良解围
points.description: 1429年4月，贞德抵达被英军围困近半年的奥尔良。她迅速成为法军的象征和精神领袖，穿着白色盔甲，手持白色旗帜，上面写着'耶稣-玛丽亚'。在她的鼓舞下，法军士气大振。5月4日至8日，贞德领导了一系列成功的军事行动，包括夺取英军的重要据点图尔elles和渡桥。5月8日，英军被迫解除对奥尔良的围困，这是百年战争中的重大转折点。贞德的军事才能和领导力在这一战役中得到了充分展现，她被后人称为'奥尔良少女'。
points.descriptionEn: In April 1429, Joan arrived at Orléans, which had been besieged by English forces for nearly six months. She quickly became a symbol and spiritual leader for the French army, wearing white armor and carrying a white banner inscribed with 'Jesus-Maria'. Under her inspiration, French morale soared. From May 4-8, Joan led a series of successful military actions, including capturing key English strongholds at Tourelles and the bridge. On May 8, the English were forced to lift the siege of Orléans, a major turning point in the Hundred Years' War. Joan's military talent and leadership were fully demonstrated in this battle, earning her the title 'The Maid of Orléans'.

points.title: 加冕仪式
points.description: 奥尔良解围后，贞德继续随军北上，目标是兰斯，法国传统上的加冕之地。7月16日，法军攻占兰斯，7月17日，查理七世在兰斯大教堂正式加冕为法国国王，贞德手持她的旗帜站在国王身旁。这一仪式具有重大的政治和象征意义，它确认了查理七世的合法王权，并极大地提升了法国的士气。然而，贞德未能说服查理七世继续向巴黎进军，错失了进一步扩大战果的机会。这一决定后来被视为贞德政治生涯中的一个遗憾，也反映了国王对她军事建议的有限采纳。
points.descriptionEn: After the lifting of the siege at Orléans, Joan continued north with the army, aiming for Reims, the traditional site of French coronations. On July 16, the French army captured Reims, and on July 17, Charles VII was formally crowned King of France at Reims Cathedral, with Joan holding her banner beside him. This ceremony had significant political and symbolic meaning, confirming Charles VII's legitimate claim to the throne and greatly boosting French morale. However, Joan failed to convince Charles VII to continue the advance toward Paris, missing an opportunity to further expand French gains. This decision was later seen as a regret in Joan's political career, reflecting the king's limited adoption of her military advice.

points.title: 囚禁与殉道
points.description: 1430年5月23日，在康皮涅战役中，贞德被勃艮第派俘虏，随后被卖给英国人。英国人将她视为威胁和宣传工具，将她囚禁在鲁昂的城堡中。在长达一年的审判中，贞德面临由英国支持的教会法庭的指控，包括异端、巫术和穿着男性服装等。尽管面对严刑拷打和死亡威胁，贞德坚持自己的信念和使命。1431年5月30日，19岁的贞德在鲁昂的老市场广场被处以火刑。她的死激起了法国人民的愤怒和团结，最终推动了法国在百年战争中的胜利。1456年，教会重新审判并宣布贞德无罪，1920年被天主教会封为圣徒，成为法国民族英雄和天主教圣人。
points.descriptionEn: On May 23, 1430, during the Battle of Compiègne, Joan was captured by the Burgundians and subsequently sold to the English. The English saw her as a threat and propaganda tool, imprisoning her in a castle in Rouen. During her year-long trial, Joan faced charges of heresy, witchcraft, and cross-dressing by an ecclesiastical court backed by the English. Despite facing torture and threats of death, Joan remained steadfast in her beliefs and mission. On May 30, 1431, the 19-year-old Joan was burned at the stake in the Old Market Square of Rouen. Her death sparked outrage and unity among the French people, ultimately contributing to France's victory in the Hundred Years' War. In 1456, the Church retried her and declared her innocent, and in 1920 she was canonized as a saint by the Catholic Church, becoming a French national hero and Catholic saint.

supporter.zh: 圣女贞德被视为法国的民族英雄和天主教圣人，她的勇气和坚定信念激励了无数人。支持者认为她是一位受上帝指引的先知，她的军事才能和领导力在百年战争中拯救了法国。贞德展现了非凡的个人勇气，面对强敌和死亡威胁毫不退缩，她的牺牲精神成为法国民族认同的重要组成部分。作为天主教圣人，她象征着信仰的力量和神圣使命的召唤。
supporter.en: Joan of Arc is regarded as a French national hero and Catholic saint, whose courage and unwavering faith have inspired countless people. Supporters see her as a prophet guided by God, whose military talent and leadership saved France during the Hundred Years' War. Joan demonstrated extraordinary personal courage, facing powerful enemies and threats of death without flinching. Her sacrificial spirit has become an important part of French national identity. As a Catholic saint, she symbolizes the power of faith and the call to divine mission.

critic.zh: 批评者认为贞德的军事决策存在局限性，她未能充分理解战争的复杂性，有时过于依赖神启而非战略思考。一些历史学家质疑她的军事才能是否被后世过度夸大，认为她的成功更多归因于当时的政治环境和法国军队的士气提升。此外，贞德对异端的审判和处决也引发了争议，尽管她后来被平反，但审判过程中的不公正和宗教偏见仍被批评者视为历史污点。
critic.en: Critics argue that Joan's military decisions had limitations, as she failed to fully grasp the complexities of warfare, sometimes relying too heavily on divine visions rather than strategic thinking. Some historians question whether her military talents have been exaggerated by posterity, suggesting her success was more due to the political climate and the boost to French morale. Additionally, Joan's trial and execution for heresy have been controversial, and although she was later exonerated, the injustices and religious biases during her trial are still seen by critics as historical stains.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，贞德被复杂地定义为多重符号。她既是军事天才又是宗教神秘主义者，既是民族英雄又是悲剧人物。历史学者将她置于中世纪晚期宗教政治和社会变革的背景下分析，强调她如何成为法国民族主义和女性力量的象征。在流行文化中，贞德的形象经历了从宗教圣徒到女权主义偶像的转变，她的故事被改编成无数文学作品、戏剧和电影，反映了不同时代对勇气、信仰和女性角色的理解与诠释。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Joan is complexly defined as multiple symbols. She is simultaneously a military genius and a religious mystic, both a national hero and a tragic figure. Historians analyze her within the context of late medieval religious politics and social change, emphasizing how she became a symbol of French nationalism and female strength. In popular culture, Joan's image has evolved from religious saint to feminist icon, with her story adapted into countless literary works, plays, and films, reflecting different eras' understandings and interpretations of courage, faith, and female roles.

self.zh: 我宁可死也不愿放弃我的旗帜。
self.en: I would rather die than abandon my banner.

others.zh: 她是历史上最伟大的战士之一，她的勇气和信念超越了时代。
others.en: She was one of the greatest warriors in history, whose courage and faith transcended her time.
